LanguageData.LP_Rec1: All animations and effects on, normal strength.
LanguageData.LP_Rec2: Performance: Medium – animals animated, dust only when running.
LanguageData.LP_Rec3: Nothing is animated outside the camera view or when zoomed far out.
LanguageData.LP_YayoWarn: Yayo's Animation is active. Lively Pawns leaves pawn movement to it and only adds its effects (muzzle flash, smoke, shells, dust). For Lively Pawns' movement, switch Yayo's Animation off – don't run both.
LanguageData.LP_Motion_Desc: Master switch for all pawn movement.
LanguageData.LP_Walk_Desc: Steps bob with speed; limping on a hurt leg, shuffling when exhausted, leaning forward when drafted; carrying makes steps heavier.
LanguageData.LP_Work_Desc: Own motion for each kind of work: hammering (building, smithing, crafting), mining swing, stirring a pot, bending over plants, nodding over research and books, sweeping, eating.
LanguageData.LP_Combat_Desc: Recoil after each shot (pawn and weapon), wind-up and lunge in melee, a flinch when hit.
LanguageData.LP_Rest_Desc: Breathing while standing and sleeping, now and then turning in bed.
LanguageData.LP_Idle_Desc: Shifting weight and glancing aside while waiting; small gestures while chatting.
LanguageData.LP_Animals_Desc: Animals bob while walking and dip their heads while grazing (not on Low performance).
LanguageData.LP_Muzzle_Desc: A glow and a short flare at the barrel on every shot – warm for bullets, blue for charge and energy weapons, big and orange for launchers. Bows and thrown weapons have none.
LanguageData.LP_Smoke_Desc: A small puff of smoke drifting from the barrel.
LanguageData.LP_Shells_Desc: Bullet guns throw out a spinning brass casing (not on Low performance).
LanguageData.LP_Footsteps: Dust and snow under the feet
LanguageData.LP_Footsteps_Desc: Running on soil or sand raises dust, on snow a puff of snow. Medium: only running pawns; High: everyone walking.
LanguageData.LP_EffectSize_Desc: How big the flashes and puffs are.
LanguageData.LP_Perf_Desc: Low: colonists only, fewer effects, effects stop sooner when zooming out. Medium: animals too, dust only when running. High: everything, more effects per frame. Pawns outside the camera view are never animated, and nothing is animated when zoomed far out (the game draws pawns as cached pictures there).
